1. **Incident liên quan đến Cache Purge:**
   * Có một incident hiện đang mở (trạng thái *identified*) mang tên **"Fedramp Customers have Delayed Purges"** (Mã incident: `wp49bp8bqo6c`, bắt đầu từ ngày 06/11/2026).

updates.body:
On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams.
